sourceAsset: Poly Haven Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy Pure Sky
basis: Real orthonormal spherical harmonics in source xyz; order [Y00,Y1-1,Y10,Y11,Y2-2,Y2-1,Y20,Y21,Y22]
convolution: Diffuse irradiance divided by pi, Lambert convolution factors [1,2/3,2/3,2/3,1/4,1/4,1/4,1/4,1/4]
solarTreatment: Upper-sky luminance above 99.9 percentile (13.154316875) replaced by non-solar weighted sky mean before integration. The runtime separately evaluates the directional sun.
groundTreatment: Lower hemisphere replaced by Lambertian ground bounce using diffuse ground albedo [0.075,0.10,0.035] and measured upper-sky horizontal irradiance. This is a declared scene approximation.
rotation: Source sun azimuth minus current sun azimuth, identical vertical-axis rotation to the photographic background.
backgroundExposureTreatment: The separate 1.25 photographic background exposure adjustment is not multiplied into diffuse-light energy.
